project_info.tagline: Des espaces plus propres, une vie meilleure

design_archetype.archetype: Organic Precision & Premium Eco-Boutique (Hybrid Archetype 1 + Swiss Clarity)
design_archetype.description: Fusion of high-end architectural studio aesthetics and organic eco-friendly purity. Deep slate tone contrast with fresh emerald green accents and soft translucent teal glass elements. Uses asymmetric Swiss grid rules, generous whitespace, kinetic typography, and editorial scrollytelling.
design_archetype.emotional_tone: Prestigious, spotlessly fresh, trustworthy, modern, hyper-reliable

colors.theme: Light mode primary with rich dark slate contrast sections

rules.tinted_greys: Always tint greys with a subtle cyan/teal hue (#0F172A instead of pure #000000).
rules.contrast_wcag: Text over teal buttons must be white with min 4.5:1 ratio. Text on emerald chips must be deep emerald or white.

visual_enhancers.dark_glass: backdrop-blur-xl bg-slate-900/85 border border-white/10 text-white shadow-2xl
visual_enhancers.tracing_beam_border: Subtle 1px glowing line around featured service cards and contact form container.
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle ambient gradient mesh orb behind hero section and clean dot-grid background patterns.

hero_cta.style: gros bouton appeler avec micro-animation pulsante et icône de téléphone

navigation_structure.mobile: Sticky top bar with quick call action + drawer menu

sections.name: Hero Section
sections.components: Kinetic Hero with line-by-line staggered text reveal, animated badge ('LUSAVONZO • Nettoyage d'exception'), dual CTAs: Big Call button 'Appeler 438 923 9052' and 'Demander un devis rapide', plus floating high-trust stats badges (100% Satisfait, Éco-Produits, Intervention 24/7).

sections.name: Editorial Marquee
sections.components: Infinite slow scrolling marquee ticker highlighting core values: 'NETTOYAGE RÉSIDENTIEL • COMMERCIALE & BUREAUX • LOCAUX INDUSTRIELS • PRODUITS ÉCO-RESPONSABLES • SERVICE FLEXIBLE & FIABLE • SANITATION DE POINTE'.

sections.name: Services Overview (Tetris Bento Grid)
sections.components: 3 interactive bento grid cards displaying Residential, Commercial, and Industrial cleaning with hover image expansions, feature tags, and quick link to full service page.

sections.name: Numbered Manifesto Chapters
sections.components: 4 chapters explaining Lusavonzo's standard: 01. Analyse & Planification, 02. Produits Éco-Certifiés, 03. Exécution de Précision, 04. Contrôle Qualité Rigoureux.

sections.name: Interactive Quick Quote Calculator Preview
sections.components: Simple visual slider/selector allowing clients to pick surface type and estimated size, showing estimated time & direct contact shortcut.

sections.name: Client Reviews & Guarantee Section
sections.components: Testimonial carousel with star ratings, verified badge, and 100% Satisfaction Guarantee banner.

sections.name: Prominent Call to Action Banner
sections.components: Dark Slate background container with huge call button and direct SMS link.

sections.name: Services Header
sections.components: Headline 'Nos Solutions de Nettoyage Sur Mesure', filter tabs (Tous, Résidentiel, Commercial, Industriel, Grand Nettoyage).

sections.name: Detailed Service Cards Grid
sections.components: Expanded service blocks for: 1. Nettoyage Résidentiel Intérieur/Extérieur, 2. Commerces, Bureaux & Espaces Pros, 3. Sites Industriels & Après-Chantier, 4. Nettoyage en Profondeur & Désinfection, 5. Traitement Éco-Sûr de Surfaces.

sections.name: Service Comparison Table
sections.components: Interactive feature breakdown table detailing what's included in Regular vs Deep vs Commercial cleaning.

sections.name: FAQ Accordion
sections.components: Shadcn Accordion answering frequency, equipment provided, eco-product safety, payment methods, and booking delays.

sections.name: Brand Story
sections.components: Narrative hero introducing LUSAVONZO's origin, philosophy ('Des espaces plus propres, une vie meilleure'), and commitment to eco-friendly excellence.

sections.name: Core Pillars
sections.components: 4 visual pillars: Fiabilité Absolue, Écologie Active, Équipe Qualifiée, Transparence Totale.

sections.name: Eco Products Highlight
sections.components: Showcase of eco-safe cleaning agents, zero harmful chemicals guarantee, safe for pets, children, and indoor air quality.

sections.name: Service Area Map & Hours
sections.components: Visual coverage card listing regions served (Grand Montréal & environs) and operating hours.

sections.name: Contact Hero
sections.components: Title 'Demandez Votre Devis ou Contactez-Nous Instantanément', prompt call action card.

sections.name: Frontend Direct Dispatcher Form (Email vs SMS Toggle)
sections.components: Client chooses preferred contact mode: '📱 SMS Instantané (438 923 9052)' OR '✉️ Courriel (bizuka70@gmail.com)'. Fields: Nom complet, Téléphone, Adresse / Ville, Type de Service (Résidentiel, Commercial, Industriel, Grand Nettoyage), Fréquence souhaitée, Message / Détails. Clicking Submit dynamically generates and triggers prefilled mailto: or sms: link!

sections.name: Direct Action Hub
sections.components: One-click giant call button (`tel:4389239052`), direct SMS button (`sms:4389239052`), and direct email link (`mailto:bizuka70@gmail.com`).

effects: Staggered entrance animations on page load and route changes
Hover scaling and light bleed glow on service cards
Pulsing ring effect around the main 'Appeler' button to command immediate visual attention
Sticky floating call button on mobile screens

testing_data_testid_convention.mandatory_rule: All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, links, tabs, form controls) MUST contain clear data-testid attributes.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure client-side routing is seamlessly implemented using React Router DOM.
Ensure French language is used throughout the copy with flawless grammar and high-end tone.

Implement the Contact page dispatcher so when the user fills out the form and chooses SMS or Email, clicking the submit button opens `mailto:bizuka70@gmail.com?subject=...&body=...` or `sms:4389239052?body=...` with full prefilled context.
Place the big 'Appeler (438) 923-9052' call button prominently in the navbar, in the Hero, in the section callouts, and as a floating button on mobile screens.
Ensure all components follow the specified data-testid naming conventions.
Integrate the image URLs provided for residential, commercial, and eco-product showcases.
